result.reason: The added language substantially tracks the preferred position for termination: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion. However, it applies only upon termination and not expiry, as expressly required. Drafting is also weakened by the dangling “and Kubient shall” after the completed subsection and by inconsistent data terminology; the new return obligation should be integrated as an additional numbered subclause and use the defined term “Customer Data.”
